name: PNG DataCo Primary Data Centre (Gerehu Earth Station)
notes: PNG DataCo official data center services page confirms a Tier 3, ISO 27001-certified (CERT NO: IS27-2022-0130) sovereign hosting facility with rack space, redundant power/cooling, 24/7 monitoring and DR hosting; head office at Waigani (Savannah Heights), facility per DataCenterMap at DataCo Earth Station Rd, Gerehu, Port Moresby (NCD). APAC Outlook (B) describes DataCo's Tier 3 data centre delivering cloud/IaaS/PaaS/SaaS. No public MW/racks stated; capacity null per methodology.

name: Sovereign AI Data Centre (Telikom / Datec / CloudSigma)
notes: KCH (state holding, A-grade announcement) reports official pre-launch 2026-03-30 of PNG's first Sovereign AI Data Centre by Telikom Limited with Datec PNG and CloudSigma, framed as a 'strategic national asset' for sovereign hosting of national data. Exact physical site not disclosed in announcement; Datec/Telikom facilities are Port Moresby (NCD)-based per operator pages, so provisionally attributed to NCD. A for launch/partners; B for physical facility/capacity (none published) - capacity null, status announced (pre-launched per methodology).

name: PNG Government National Data Centre (Huawei-built, IGIS)
notes: Government data repository/operations centre built by Huawei, opened c.2018 in Port Moresby (NCD); DCD reported serious security/maintenance failures in 2020. Current operational status/quality uncertain - verify against current DICT/GovCloud documents before marking fully active. B-grade trade press evidence; capacity not published (null).

name: Vodafone PNG main data centre (Port Moresby)
notes: APAC Outlook operator profile states Vodafone PNG's office in Port Moresby (NCD) houses the main data centre, with regional data centres planned to commence in Lae then Mount Hagen. B-grade trade-press/operator-profile evidence; capacity not published (null).

name: Datec PNG data centre (Port Moresby, Poreporena Freeway)
notes: Datec official pages confirm datacenter service offering (cloud, equipment colocation, disaster recovery, BCP) with >99.99% uptime claim; directory evidence (Inflect, Data Center Journal) places facility on Poreporena Freeway, Port Moresby (NCD). A for operator service/existence; facility address via directory (C/B-). Capacity null.

name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) data and operations centres
developer: Bank of South Pacific; engineered by RPS
notes: RPS (consulting engineer) project page confirms delivery of BSP data and operations centres in Papua New Guinea (Port Moresby/NCD); enterprise/private facility, not commercial colo. A-grade vendor project reference. Capacity null.

name: PNG DataCo Madang data centre / cable landing station (Modilon Rd)
notes: TechInPacific (B) citing Business Advantage PNG interview: PNG DataCo operates data centers in Port Moresby and Madang, plus plans for Caution Bay SEZ (Central), Lae SEZ (Morobe), Islands and Highlands sites. Post Courier (2019) reported DataCo building a DR data centre in Madang alongside a Port Moresby centre. DataCenterMap lists PNG DataCo Madang CLS on Modilon Rd; Madang is the PPC-1 international cable landing and Kumul Submarine Cable Network hub (2019). B for interview/press; C for directory address details. Capacity null.

name: Vodafone PNG regional data centre (Mount Hagen)
notes: APAC Outlook operator profile: Vodafone PNG plans regional data centres 'shortly commencing in Lae, then later on, Mount Hagen' (Western Highlands). B/C until NICTA/operator/permit confirmation; status announced/planned per methodology (regional centre plan, no physical site verified). Capacity null.
